summary.headline: Māshāʾallāh’s Three Books
summary.text: Title page for Māshāʾallāh’s three books: Book I on the revolution of the years of the world, Book II on planetary significations in nativities, and Book III on reception, each with an index. Dedicated to Augustus, Georg Ernest Count of Henneberg, and published by Joachim Heller in Nuremberg in 1549.
